preserved_semantics: Gap-driven search seeds carry explicit acceptance targets and STOP conditions.
Public technical sources are allowlisted; private/customer/bank/ledger gaps do not enter public Hunter search.
Search telemetry preserves candidate and deep-inspection denominators.
Negative/no-find information is retained instead of discarded.
Exact repository revision and capability identity are part of deduplication.
Independent verification is distinct from discovery.
Outcome attribution is explicit and realized outcomes outrank repository popularity or predicted commercial scores.
Strategy adaptation requires sufficient measured evidence rather than one anecdote.
